metadata.title: Architectural Systemics of oeneyeOS: Automated Telemetry and S 4.3 Radiation Security Confinement
metadata.description: This monograph details the software-defined proxy control loops and telemetry architectures implemented within the oeneyeOS environment, integrating GMT-X temporal synchronization, 5:6 harmonic gear ratios, and S 4.3 Maximum Radiant Density confinement frameworks.
